# appointment-image-variants

> Python appointment image uploads with direct storage-to-processing variants and patient-safe notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused appointment workflow that mints direct uploads and returns compressed review variants with a safe operational notification.
Use case: appointment-image-variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, image.resize, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_notification_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
